catalogDescriptions.METHANE: Explosive gas hazard in underground coal and some hard-rock mines — continuous monitoring is a statutory requirement.
catalogDescriptions.CARBON_MONOXIDE: Indicator of fire/combustion underground; early warning for spontaneous combustion and equipment exhaust.
catalogDescriptions.OXYGEN: Confirms breathable atmosphere; low readings signal displacement by other gases or poor ventilation.
catalogDescriptions.TEMPERATURE: Heat stress management and early fire/overheating detection.
catalogDescriptions.HUMIDITY: Affects heat stress risk and dust behaviour; monitored alongside temperature.
catalogDescriptions.SEISMIC: Detects rock mass movement associated with rockfalls and rockbursts.
catalogDescriptions.AIR_FLOW: Confirms the ventilation plan is delivering the required airflow to each working place.
catalogDescriptions.DUST: Tracks respirable/inhalable dust exposure — key driver of occupational lung disease.
catalogDescriptions.NOISE: Tracks noise exposure to prevent noise-induced hearing loss.
catalogDescriptions.WATER_LEVEL: Flooding risk in underground workings and surface water infrastructure.
catalogDescriptions.EQUIPMENT_CONDITION: General machine health/vibration-style monitoring for critical equipment.
catalogDescriptions.CARBON_DIOXIDE: Displaces oxygen in confined spaces and indicates ventilation adequacy.
catalogDescriptions.NITROGEN_OXIDES: Diesel exhaust and blasting fume hazard, particularly in poorly ventilated headings.
catalogDescriptions.HYDROGEN_SULFIDE: Highly toxic gas hazard associated with sulphide ore bodies and stagnant water.
catalogDescriptions.RADIATION: Radon/gamma monitoring required in uranium and some gold operations.
catalogDescriptions.SMOKE_FIRE: Early fire detection in conveyor systems, workshops and electrical installations.
catalogDescriptions.VIBRATION: Structural and rotating-equipment health monitoring — early bearing/mounting failure warning.
catalogDescriptions.PRESSURE: Pipeline, pump and pneumatic system integrity monitoring.
catalogDescriptions.FLOW_RATE: Water/slurry pipeline throughput monitoring for process and dewatering systems.
catalogDescriptions.CONVEYOR_ALIGNMENT: Belt mistracking is a common fire and mechanical-failure cause on conveyor systems.
catalogDescriptions.PROXIMITY_COLLISION: Vehicle/pedestrian collision avoidance around heavy mobile equipment.
catalogDescriptions.GPS_LOCATION: Fleet and personnel location tracking for safety and dispatch.
catalogDescriptions.PUMP_STATUS: Dewatering pump run/fail status — critical for flood control.
catalogDescriptions.FAN_STATUS: Main and auxiliary ventilation fan run/fail status.
catalogDescriptions.ACCESS_CONTROL: Restricted-area door/access monitoring for security and explosives magazines.
